I've had Rosacea since my late 20's, it's commonly known as the 'Curse of the Celts', as it affects the fair skinned. Not wanting to stay on antibiotics full time and exhausting Chinese medicine, Bach Remedies and so many other alternative options, I have developed a very simple, cheap routine which has worked for me. I use olive oil on my skin to cleanse - any supermarket brand will do! If you find it too greasy use a damp cotton pad to remove excess. Morning and night, after using the olive oil, I put on Nivea moisturiser, followed by a small amount of factor 30 on my forehead, nose, cheeks and chin. I use vaseline on my eyes and lashes at night time. I have been doing this for over 20 years and I am regularly complemented on my skin and friends say I look years younger than my age. If you have Rosacea this might work for you.
